?[%{{profile_address}}...What would you like to be called?]
?[%{{profile_background}}...What is your professional background, identity, and relevant experience?]
?[%{{profile_expression_style}}...What expression style do you prefer?]
?[%{{profile_slide_style}}...What slide style do you prefer?]
?[%{{profile_recent_interests}}...What have you been focusing on recently?]

externalAgent.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the prompt manually.
externalAgent.prompt:
Based on what you already know about me, write a personal learning profile that I can paste directly into a learning product. Include only:
- What you usually call me
- My professional background, identity, and relevant experience
- My preferred expression style
- My preferred slide style
- What I have been focusing on recently
Write it as first-person plain text, keep it within 1,000 characters, and do not add information from other areas.
